description: MainActivity.kt: This Kotlin source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application that provides a UI to toggle the device's flashlight (torch). It manages camera permissions, detects a back-facing camera with flash, and controls the torch state while updating the UI accordingly.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity is an Android Activity that provides a button to toggle the flashlight (torch). It handles camera permissions, camera initialization, torch control, and UI updates based on torch state and permissions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the activity, initializes camera manager and UI, and finds a suitable back camera with flash.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Re-scans camera availability and updates UI when activity becomes visible.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates the UI when activity resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Turns off the torch when the activity goes to background.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up references and unregisters callbacks.

methods.name: handleToggleClick
methods.description: Handles button click events to toggle torch, requesting permission if needed.

methods.name: requestCameraPermissionIfNeeded
methods.description: Requests camera permission if not already granted.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of permission requests and re-initializes camera if permission granted.

methods.name: retryToggleAfterPermission
methods.description: Attempts to toggle torch again after permission is granted.

methods.name: turnTorchSafe
methods.description: Safely toggles torch state, catching security exceptions.

methods.name: turnTorchInternal
methods.description: Directly sets the torch mode via CameraManager.

methods.name: findBackCameraWithFlash
methods.description: Finds a back-facing camera with flash capability.

methods.name: registerTorchCallbackSafe
methods.description: Registers or unregisters TorchCallback to listen for torch state changes.

methods.name: updateUi
methods.description: Updates the button state and label based on torch availability and state.
